messages:
Hannah L: quick heads-up  noticed the weekly KPI board shows a sharp lift in "launch-post" conversions the morning after the new webinar teaser went live. before we push this to execs, can analytics + growth sanity-check? :wave:

Marcus P: on it. my first pass: sessions and clicks are up, but CRM-accepted leads are flat. could be shallow funnel noise (higher N but lower quality), or some routing change.

Ivy Q: we did flip a lightweight reroute for inbound webinar leads last week (prioritize direct-sync to CRM for known domains). that went live 2023-11-01 08:12 UTC. might change the timing of CRM acceptance. logging the change here.

Ben R: also FYI we pushed a modified subject line for the teaser on 2023-10-31 (variant D). open rate looked higher in the first 12 hours. need to split the uplift between messaging (variant effect) and telemetry artifacts.

Hannah L: two asks: 1) analytics to add a reconciled "crm_vs_streaming" comparison series and annotate the routing flip; 2) growth to surface variant-D cohort performance (registrations, demos, accepted leads).

Marcus P: will add the series. plan: compute daily streaming signups vs CRM accepted and an attribution confidence score. quick SQL sketch:
```sql
SELECT day,
  SUM(stream_signups) AS streaming_signups,
  SUM(crm_accepted) AS crm_accepted,
  CASE WHEN streaming_signups = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE ROUND(100*SUM(crm_accepted)/SUM(stream_signups),1)
  END AS pct_match
FROM (
  SELECT date AS day, COUNT(*) AS stream_signups, 0 AS crm_accepted FROM streaming.signup_events WHERE date BETWEEN '2023-10-28' AND '2023-11-04' GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT accept_date AS day, 0 AS stream_signups, COUNT(*) AS crm_accepted FROM crm.leads WHERE accept_date BETWEEN '2023-10-28' AND '2023-11-04' AND campaign='launch-teaser' GROUP BY accept_date
) AS t
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

Ivy Q: i'll export the subject-variant cohort (variant D vs others) and attach CTR -> demo -> accepted conversion rates to the campaign doc so we can attribute messaging lift. variant-D had +1.9x opens in the sample but slightly lower demo conversion so far.

Ben R: note: there was also a lightweight A/B in the nurture cadence where variant-D got a shorter sequence; that could accelerate early opens but reduce downstream demo conversion. worth controlling for.

Hannah L: agreed. can we also add a "source_confidence" flag to the KPI board (high/medium/low) so when streaming and CRM diverge we don't push noisy signals to execs? low confidence = streaming-only blips, medium = streaming+partial crm, high = streaming+crm sync.

dashbot: dashboard update: added "crm_vs_streaming" series and temporary annotation "routing change: inbound-priority sync on 2023-11-01 08:12 UTC" (annotation id: a-20231101-routing). public board: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-weekly

Marcus P: backfill kicked for 2023-10-28..2023-11-04 to compute reconciled numbers. ETA ~45m. I'll post results and the pct_match table when ready.

Hannah L: perfect. once backfill is done please post a 2-line note for the exec digest with the corrected weekly numbers and a short line on message vs routing impact. want to avoid surprise pings. thanks all :raised_hands:
